newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APT Satellite debuts at HK$13.50/share.
newsitem.headline: APT Satellite debuts at HK$13.50/share.

text.p: Shares of satellite services provider APT Satellite Holdings Ltd made their trading debut at HK$13.50 per share, compared with their issue price of HK$13.40 per share.
The China-backed company offered 105 million shares globally. The U.S. and international portion of 94.5 million shares was moderately oversubscribed.
Shares offered to employees were 27.9 percent subscribed, and its initial public offering in Hong Kong of 9.45 million shares had been only 65.5 percent subscribed.
APT Satellite said the IPO proceeds would be used to repay loans and to fund its future satellite projects.
